source_note: BMAD Method 6.12.0 (npm bmad-method@6.12.0, installed 21 Sep 2026 with `install --yes --directory <copy> --modules bmm --tools claude-code` into a copy of base/frai): the with side's overlay is exactly the .claude/skills/bmad-* skills and _bmad/ it wrote. With: '/bmad-build-auto ' plus the task text, one call; the skill clarifies, plans, implements and reviews with its own review subagents. Without: the task text only. Both sides: skills on, Agent, git add/commit and uv run allowed (BMAD renders its skills with `uv run`), 30-minute cap. The analyst, PM and architect chain is not tested; BMAD reserves it for larger work.
